cards.label: Slaughter
cards.general: The Androktasiai are divine personifications of killing people, children of Strife.
cards.here: Here they appear alongside Clashes, Battles, and Murders.

cards.label: lying Words
cards.general: The Logoi are personified deceitful speech, children of Strife.
cards.here: Here they appear between Quarrels and Arguments.

cards.label: Ruin
cards.general: Ate is a divine personification of destructive blindness and ruin, a child of Strife.
cards.here: Here she and Lawlessness are close companions.

evidence.greek: Ὑσμίνας τε Μάχας τε Φόνους τʼ Ἀνδροκτασίας τε
evidence.reason: Ἀνδροκτασίας names the personifications of killing people alongside Clashes, Battles, and Murders.

evidence.greek: Νείκεά τε ψευδέας τε Λόγους Ἀμφιλλογίας τε
evidence.reason: ψευδέας Λόγους identifies deceitful speech among Strife’s offspring, between Quarrels and Arguments.

evidence.greek: Δυσνομίην τʼ Ἄτην τε, συνήθεας ἀλλήλῃσιν,
evidence.reason: Ἄτην names Ate, and συνήθεας ἀλλήλῃσιν describes her close companionship with Lawlessness.

cards.label: Ceto
cards.general: Ceto is a sea goddess, daughter of Gaia and Pontus.
cards.here: Here she bears Echidna, a divine creature half nymph and half snake.

evidence.greek: ἣ δʼ ἔτεκʼ ἄλλο πέλωρον ἀμήχανον, οὐδὲν ἐοικὸς
evidence.reason: In this reading, ἣ refers to Ceto as the mother bearing the monster subsequently named Echidna.

cards.label: Zeus
cards.general: Zeus is the ruling god and a son of the Titan Cronus.
cards.here: He punishes Prometheus but consents to Heracles ending the eagle’s attack, honoring his son.

evidence.reason: Ζηνὸς names Zeus, described as ruling on high from Olympus and consenting to Heracles’ intervention.
